summary: Trivial helper that first resets the x87 FPU via FNINIT, then returns the boolean result of the comparison a1 == 0. a1 is passed in the FPU status/control word register (fpstat) per the __usercall ABI. The practical purpose of the FNINIT before the comparison is not evidenced; the whole body may be a decompiler artifact of a single inline-asm instruction sequence.

operations.description: Execute FNINIT to reset the x87 FPU to its default state before producing the result.
Return the boolean (al) result of the equality check a1 == 0, where a1 arrives in the FPU status word per the __usercall ABI.
